events.verdict: Champagnie (SAS) contests Murray's (NOP) jump shot and the contact after the release, and follow-through, is marginal.
Paul (SAS) reaches in and the contact with Murphy III's (NOP) arm is marginal.
Jones (NOP) and Paul (SAS) come together at the same spot pursuing the loose ball and the contact is incidental.
Missi (NOP) places his hands on Wembanyama's (SAS) body in the post but the contact is marginal.
Murphy III (NOP) reaches across Castle's (SAS) body at the start of his drive, and Castle moves through the contact.
Murphy III (NOP) is in a legal guarding position when he absorbs the contact initiated by Castle (SAS) during his driving shot attempt. The shot is then cleanly blocked by Missi (NOP).
Paul (SAS) rips through and the contact with Jones' (NOP) arm is marginal.

Replay review of the foul called on Murray (NOP) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed successful. Murray maintains a legal guarding position during Champagnie's (SAS) drive to the basket and then cleanly dislodges the ball from his possession.
Jones (NOP) legally contests Wembanyama's (SAS) jump shot attempt.
Wembanyama (SAS) rests a hand on Missi's (NOP) back and the contact during his shot attempt is marginal.
Missi (NOP) commits a take foul on Wembanyama (SAS).
Champagnie (SAS) wraps Murphy III (NOP) and affects his FOM.
Murphy III (NOP) moves his pivot foot prior to releasing his dribble.
Missi (NOP) grasps Wembanyama's (SAS) jersey, but Wembanyama is able to get to the rebound unaffected by the contact.
McCollum (NOP) commits a take foul on Wembanyama (SAS).
Jones (NOP) does not release the throw-in within five seconds.
